facts.text: Founded in 1896 by leaders of the Seventh-day Adventist Church on a 380-acre former plantation, Oakwood University is the only historically Black Seventh-day Adventist institution of higher learning in the United States.

sources.title: Mission & History » Oakwood University
sources.quote: The mission of Oakwood University, a historically black, Seventh-day Adventist institution, is to transform students through biblically-based education for service to God and humanity.
